newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo trades steady on mark, tight range seen.
newsitem.headline: Escudo trades steady on mark, tight range seen.

text.p: The escudo was trading quietly steady against the mark on Thursday and traders predicted the currency would remain within a narrow range throughout the session.
The escudo was at 100.89/90 to the mark against its 100.81/89 close on Wednesday. The currency was seen remaining within a band of 100.80-101.00.
The attempt of the dollar to test the 1.80 mark level and the firmness of sterling were the main international factors likely to influence the escudo, traders said.
